title: CAD IR Phase 10 — Cost compiler + integration smoke test
summary: Implementation plan adding a cost compiler, optional budget field on CadIr, budget-exceeded validation rule, and a full-stack integration smoke test for the CAD IR system.
notes: Document is an implementation plan (TDD task list) for Phase 10 of the CAD IR rebuild. Classified SPEC because it defines concrete technical contracts: type signatures (CostResult, PricingDb, CostEntry), Zod schema additions (CadIr.budget), validation rule API, and integration test contract. Competes with DOC (instructional/prose) but the dominant signal is technical specification of new code APIs and data shapes. Not an ADR (no Decision/Consequences sections, no trade-off analysis ending in one path) and not a PRD (no user stories or business requirements).
